description: India May is a Northeast Iowa nurse, public library director, county death investigator, and lifelong advocate for disability rights. She’s running for Iowa House District 58 in Chickasaw, Floyd, Bremer, & Butler counties. Help her stop censorship, discrimination, and corruption. Donate today!
